name: petty
description: Your Petty drawers as tools: balances, finding an item, history, and adding or taking cash.
long_description: Petty is an end-to-end encrypted ledger for the cash and things in your home. This add-on runs on your own computer. It holds your access token, opens your drawer keys here, and talks to your Petty server, which only ever sees ciphertext. Make a token in Petty: Settings → Access tokens.

api_url.title: Petty address
api_url.description: Your Petty's API address, shown next to the token in Settings. For example https://petty.example.com/api

token.title: Access token
token.description: The token from Settings → Access tokens. It starts with petty_pat_.

tools.name: list_drawers
tools.description: Every drawer and item the token can open, with balances

tools.name: add
tools.description: Add an amount to an item (writing tokens only)

tools.name: withdraw
tools.description: Take an amount from an item (writing tokens only)

tools.name: adjust
tools.description: Set an item to what was counted (writing tokens only)
